scope: Independent local-only review of Test23 before/after evidence verifiers and one-shot reset; no device, SSH, staging or reset actions performed.
review: All three scripts are exact previous Test22 implementations with only expected Test23 paths, source/target hashes, image names and one-block receipt field substituted.

Before verifier requires complete read-only fresh audit with exactly five partitions; exact full Test22 source size/hash; APFS clone rehash; all five local files matched to full remote read evidence before returning both-Mac receipt.

After verifier requires transaction completion, full system/protected verification, no error/reset/userdata write/in-progress block; exact full Test23 target size/hash and clone rehash; both protected copies byte/hash matched to fresh before audit and transaction rows; exact completed single-block list, original hash and target bytes.

After receipt binds the transaction hash, full system target and size, all four protected hashes and one-block verification. The reviewed system runner separately pins source/delta and all protected partitions including current misc; helpers do not relax those requirements.
Reset rehashes transaction, full target system and all four protected readbacks before opening USB; both-Mac and one-block receipt flags are mandatory and BCB first32 bytes must be zero.

Reset uses exclusive output directory and durable attempt journal, read-only configure, fresh GPT(0,14) and misc(18626584,2048) reads matched to receipt, then one power-reset XML with bounded write/ACK. No partition programs, erase, retry or user-data operation.
Reset short-write/disconnect remains recorded as an attempted/uncertain result; no ACK is fabricated and a subsequent invocation is refused by exclusive directory.

offline_tests.details: Fake Reader/USB and save_state; sparse system size with mocked system content hash; actual hashes for all other evidence. Valid once, retry journal, incomplete full readback, missing both-Mac/block receipts, changed transaction/target/fullhash/size/protected data, nonzero BCB, fresh GPT/misc mismatch, short write and disconnect.

conditions_and_limits: Run under ordinary Python with assertions enabled, as the established workflow does; do not use python -O.
This is a code/evidence-gate review, not a claim that the pending live Test23 backup, system write or after verification has completed.
Before and after verifiers copy evidence over SSH when explicitly operated by root; they were parsed/reviewed only here, never executed.
Fresh reset rechecks cover GPT/misc; boot/recovery/system rely on the fully verified preceding transaction and sole-operator same-session workflow.
APFS clone receipts compare complete content hashes to full live reads; they do not substitute a prepared image for a phone read.
